# Yum News

> Independent technology news covering AI tools, Android, and practical how-to guides for developers and curious readers.

## About

Yum News publishes practical, step-by-step guides for Android, Gemini AI, Firebase, Claude, Google Home, and developer tooling. Coverage focuses on useful product workflows — from consumer Android features to SDK-level APIs and AI integrations. Articles are written for developers, makers, and technically curious readers.

## Categories

- **AI Tools & Tutorials** — ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code Projects, Gemini, Gemini Spark, Gemma, ML Kit, Prompt API, LiteRT-LM, Firebase AI Logic, Gemini Nano Banana image models, Google AI Studio, Google Flow, Firefox Smart Window, Mistral, Google Home MCP, Notion Agent Skills, Gemini Daily Brief, Speech Recognition, Gemini in Sheets, Sheets canvas mini-apps, Gemini Gems, Gemini app for Windows, Gemini in Gmail, Gemini in Google Docs, Google Labs CC family agent, Ask Photos, Gemini Omni video, Gemini Spark Google Photos, Gboard Rambler, Android CLI, Android skills
- **Android Apps & Updates** — Android 17, Pixel drops, Pixel VIP widgets, Pixel 11 Magic Capture, Pixel Scam Detection, Gboard Rambler, Gboard warnings, Motion Assist, Find Hub Remembered items, AndroidX Security State, Circle to Search, Google Messages Keep notes, new OS features, ADB, debugging, Android CLI, Media3 MiniController
- **Technology How-To Guides** — Step-by-step walkthroughs for real-world tasks, Baseline Profiles, app performance, on-device LLMs, Android Studio Journeys, Android CLI and agent skills, Media3 Compose UI, Sheets canvas, Gemini in Docs
